title: Benign Projective Landscapes for Measured Quantum Divergences
summary: We study nonconvex optimization of measured quantum $f$-divergences over rank-one projective measurements. For smoothly operator-Fenchel liftable generators and faithful states, every projective local maximum and every second-order stationary point is globally optimal over all POVMs. The criterion is blockwise: a critical PVM is optimal exactly when the compressed states are proportional on each equal-score block; otherwise an explicit two-vector rotation has positive ascent curvature.
